title: Throw three rolled pairs of socks into an open laundry hamper standing on the floor beyond the arms' reach
instruction: Throw the three pairs of socks into the laundry hamper.
context: Tossing balled-up socks into the hamper from across the room is something most people do every laundry day. The hamper stands out of reach, so the socks must be thrown: swung up to about 2.2 m/s and let go in a window about 0.1 s wide: in the demo's swing, opening the hand on either of two consecutive 50 ms control steps works; two steps earlier the pair drops on or beside the table, one step later it is flung down short.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); the table top is 76 cm above the floor, 110 cm (x) by 130 cm (y), its far edge at x 91, its sides at y +-65. (1) Hamper: Household Essentials round pop-up mesh laundry hamper, green polyester mesh on steel hoops, 40.6 cm across, 63.5 cm tall, 400 g, open top, standing upright on the floor centred at x 100, y -87, just off the table's right side (its wall 2 cm clear of the table's side edge at y -65) near the far corner, its rim 12.5 cm below the table top. (2)-(4) Three pairs of cotton crew socks, each pair rolled into its own cuff, about 8 x 6 x 5.5 cm and 40 g, lying flat on the table: white at x 22, y -20 (long axis 20 deg from x), grey at x 30, y -33 (-10 deg), black at x 20, y -44 (75 deg). Distractors, ignored by the scorer: (5) a folded microfibre towel (20.5 x 21.2 x 3.4 cm, 100 g) at x 24, y 20; (6) a paper notebook (22.9 x 17.0 x 1.0 cm, 120 g) at x 50, y 30; (7) a ceramic mug (11.4 x 9.0 x 8.0 cm, 300 g) at x 62, y 5. Both arms start at the ready pose, grippers open.
scoring: A pair is in when its centre is inside the hamper wall (less than 18.3 cm from the hamper's axis), lower than 60.5 cm above the hamper's floor (3 cm below the rim) and above that floor, and it is still (under 5 cm/s). The hamper must stand where it was put: upright within 10 deg, its base centre within 5 cm of its floor marks; otherwise the score is 0. Score: pairs in divided by 3 (0, 0.33 or 0.67; all three in before the hold below completes also scores 0.67); 1.0 when all three are in, with the hamper standing and every gripper fingertip 30 cm or more from the hamper, for 1 s. Possible scores: 0, 0.33, 0.67, 1.0. Any number of throws within the run limit; a pair that ends anywhere else (table, floor, perched on the rim) does not count. Doing nothing scores 0. Real trial: a tape measure on floor marks for the hamper, and a look into the hamper at the end.
reset_notes: Take the socks out of the hamper and lay them on their taped outlines; stand the hamper back on its four floor marks.
fidelity: Each rolled pair is one rigid flattened ellipsoid (8 x 6 x 5.5 cm, 40 g), friction 0.9/0.8, no bounce; real sock balls are soft and squash in the grip. The hamper is a free 400 g body, 40.6 cm across and 63.5 cm tall: 24 rigid wall panels 3 cm thick outside the inner face and a 2.5 cm floor disc (thick so a fast sock can't tunnel through); the real mesh gives a little. No air drag (small for a 40 g ball at 2.2 m/s over 1 m). Distractors are SimReady props.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 (no pair released; the Dream API stopped the run with a refusal at step 656 of 1,200, so the harness recorded no score); demo: 1.0
